description: This file implements a Kubernetes bootstrap signer controller responsible for signing ConfigMaps with bootstrap tokens, managing secrets and ConfigMaps, and ensuring signatures are up-to-date.

classes.name: SignerOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration options for the Signer controller, including namespace and resync durations.

methods.name: NewSigner
methods.description: Creates a new Signer controller with provided Kubernetes client, informers, and options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the Signer controller's event loops and waits for shutdown.

methods.name: signConfigMap
methods.description: Computes and updates signatures on the ConfigMap if needed.

methods.name: getConfigMap
methods.description: Retrieves the current ConfigMap being managed.

methods.name: listSecrets
methods.description: Lists bootstrap token secrets from the cache.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Returns a map of token IDs to secrets, validating each token.
